title: scRNA integration (Melody)

n_hvg.note: select top-N highly variable genes before PCA (0 = all genes; OSCA suggests more HVGs for integration, ~2000-5000)

harmony2.note: opt-in Harmony2 mode: stabilized scale-invariant diversity penalty + dynamic per-batch ridge (lambda_hat=alpha*E), reducing over-integration in heterogeneous data (default off = the validated 2019 method)

alpha.note: Harmony2 dynamic-lambda scale (only used when harmony2=true)

background: Selom Melody batch-corrects and co-embeds multiple single-cell libraries — a clean-room, pure-numpy reimplementation of the Harmony integration method (Korsunsky et al. 2019) built from the paper, with no GPL dependency on the shipped path. Validated against the harmonypy oracle; emits the before→after batch-mixing score as provenance.

references.title: Fast, sensitive and accurate integration of single-cell data with Harmony

catalog.name: Selom Melody
catalog.summary: Batch-correct and co-embed multiple single-cell libraries with Selom Melody — our clean-room, pure-numpy implementation of the Harmony integration method (Korsunsky et al. 2019), with no GPL dependency. QC → normalize → PCA → Melody on the chosen batch key → neighbours/Leiden/UMAP on the corrected embedding. Mixes batches while preserving cell-type structure — the prerequisite for building or benchmarking against a reference atlas. Emits the before→after batch-mixing score as provenance. Optional harmony2=true folds in the Harmony2 (2026) anti-over-integration improvements for large, heterogeneous data.
